property_summary: For all callers, calling DrugDealer() on the reference contract only succeeds (or only the CEO can set ceoAddress) when invoked by the existing ceoAddress (i.e., ceoAddress remains unchanged unless called by the current CEO); the mutant allows any caller to change ceoAddress to themselves, which violates this invariant for some caller addresses.
change_summary: Replace the require condition so any caller can set ceoAddress to themselves (removes CEO-only restriction).
